mount.__note: FC-FONT-SUBSTRATE ROOT CAUSE (the Times defect), FIXED HERE. The old mount imported the three stylesheets but wrapped stages in a bare fragment — and EVERY token in @astryxdesign/theme-neutral/dist/theme.css lives inside '@scope ([data-astryx-theme="neutral"]) to ([data-astryx-theme])' blocks (theme.css:9/84/509). With no element carrying that attribute the scope never matched, so no theme token — Figtree included — ever resolved; core astryx.css's :root fallbacks covered components that reference var(--font-family-body) directly (Switch label captured the -apple-system stack), but Button's <button> only has reset.css's form-control 'font-family: inherit', inherits from an UNSTYLED body (the base font is applied by the Theme provider's own wrapper div, stylex class x9ynric = font-family:var(--font-family-body)), and computed to the browser default: literal 'Times', 104 nodes of it in the committed captured truth. The fix is the library's own documented mount (README Quick Start): wrap in <Theme theme={neutralTheme}> — its wrapper div carries data-astryx-theme='neutral' (resolving every @scope'd token at capture) AND the base font-family, exactly what a real consumer renders under. Captured truth recaptured under this mount carries 'Figtree, -apple-system, ...' and the committed Figtree faces below render it.
